hand-wraps-duct-tape.name: ★ Hand Wraps | Duct Tape
hand-wraps-duct-tape.desc: Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching. These scavenged hand-wraps are surprisingly durable but not especially breathable.

moto-gloves-3rd-commando-company.name: ★ Moto Gloves | 3rd Commando Company
moto-gloves-3rd-commando-company.desc: These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph.

specialist-gloves-fade.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Fade
specialist-gloves-fade.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating. These multicolored gloves have metallic accents.

specialist-gloves-crimson-web.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Crimson Web
specialist-gloves-crimson-web.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating. These red and grey gloves have been printed with a rubberized webs pattern.

sport-gloves-creme-pinstripe.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Creme Pinstripe
sport-gloves-creme-pinstripe.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

sport-gloves-bronze-morph.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Bronze Morph
sport-gloves-bronze-morph.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching. These synthetic red and green gloves are quick drying and breathable.

ak-47-autoexec.name: AK-47 | AUTOEXEC
ak-47-autoexec.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with a high gloss blue and pink gradient and a number of graphic designs.

"Kill" in console

aug-midnight-lily.name: AUG | Midnight Lily
aug-midnight-lily.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A pattern of lilies has been applied using pearlescent, color changing paint.

While beautiful, lilies are most often associated with death

aug-navy-murano.name: AUG | Navy Murano
aug-navy-murano.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A blue hydrographic of Murano beads has been applied.

Death by a thousand beads

awp-graphite.name: AWP | Graphite
awp-graphite.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. This memento from Agency has been painted in a polygon pattern with metallic paints of various reflectivities over a chrome base coat.

Pencils down, hands up

awp-longdog.name: AWP | LongDog
awp-longdog.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with the LongDog graffiti from Train.

"The greatest dog to have ever lived is the one waiting for you at home"

awp-queens-gambit.name: AWP | Queen's Gambit
awp-queens-gambit.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted using royal blue and gold. A queen has been hand painted in front of the butt stock.

Every shot is a royal decree of power and precision

awp-cmyk.name: AWP | CMYK
awp-cmyk.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a multicolored abstract design over a white base.

I knew you'd return; I just didn't expect it to be so soon... – Booth, Arms Dealer

pp-bizon-high-roller.name: PP-Bizon | High Roller
pp-bizon-high-roller.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been custom painted with poker chips, dice, and a royal flush over a red base.

All in

cz75-auto-xiangliu.name: CZ75-Auto | Xiangliu
cz75-auto-xiangliu.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. A custom paint job with nine purple and gold snakes has been applied.

Beware the rising tide

cz75-auto-pink-pearl.name: CZ75-Auto | Pink Pearl
cz75-auto-pink-pearl.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted using black and pearlescent pink.

Refined elegance

desert-eagle-bronze-deco.name: Desert Eagle | Bronze Deco
desert-eagle-bronze-deco.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted in an art deco pattern using metallic automotive paints.

Everyone's searching for silver and gold

desert-eagle-eastern-enigma.name: Desert Eagle | Eastern Enigma
desert-eagle-eastern-enigma.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted with a metallic silver, black, and blue design.

Don't lose the thread

desert-eagle-night.name: Desert Eagle | Night
desert-eagle-night.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

dual-berettas-heist.name: Dual Berettas | Heist
dual-berettas-heist.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. Its base has been painted with a beige anodized map pattern. It looks like someone has drawn on top of the map since it was first applied.

Planning is one thing, executing is another

famas-valence.name: FAMAS | Valence
famas-valence.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom painted in a modern red and grey design that complements the weapon's form.

We're always stronger together

famas-half-sleeve.name: FAMAS | Half Sleeve
famas-half-sleeve.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom painted to appear as if it's wrapped in a camo patterned jacket.

Half sleeved and fully loaded

five-seven-scumbria.name: Five-SeveN | Scumbria
five-seven-scumbria.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been discretely painted with stripes.

You can't leave him to die, Felix; you have to save him - The Daughter and the Paladin Part 1

five-seven-angry-mob.name: Five-SeveN | Angry Mob
five-seven-angry-mob.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. A brightly colored paint job inspired by street art has been applied.

"Inside voices, please"

five-seven-hybrid.name: Five-SeveN | Hybrid
five-seven-hybrid.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been custom painted with a silver base coat and bright purple stripes.

Party in the front, party in the back

g3sg1-dream-glade.name: G3SG1 | Dream Glade
g3sg1-dream-glade.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. A green forest gives way to a blue sky at the center of this custom paint job.

"There, a clearing in the forest!"

galil-ar-sugar-rush.name: Galil AR | Sugar Rush
galil-ar-sugar-rush.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been custom painted using cotton candy themed colors and various patterns.

Prepare for the crash

glock-18-fade.name: Glock-18 | Fade
glock-18-fade.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

glock-18-reactor.name: Glock-18 | Reactor
glock-18-reactor.desc: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted with a pattern of nuclear hazard symbols using metallic paints.

glock-18-wasteland-rebel.name: Glock-18 | Wasteland Rebel
glock-18-wasteland-rebel.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been distressed, block printed, and painted with graffiti.

Pay tribute

glock-18-mirror-mosaic.name: Glock-18 | Mirror Mosaic
glock-18-mirror-mosaic.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted to resemble a mosaic of mirrors.

Trapped in your own thoughts

p2000-woodsman.name: P2000 | Woodsman
p2000-woodsman.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been hand painted with custom green camouflage and orange detailing.

"The orange is for you, not me"

survival-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Survival Knife | Case Hardened
survival-knife-case-hardened.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

navaja-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Damascus Steel
navaja-knife-damascus-steel.desc: This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has some damascus steel parts.

navaja-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Forest DDPAT
navaja-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

m9-bayonet-freehand.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Freehand
m9-bayonet-freehand.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted black and purple, then decorated with a metallic marker.

nomad-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Damascus Steel
nomad-knife-damascus-steel.desc: This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has some damascus steel parts.

nomad-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Forest DDPAT
nomad-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

bowie-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Doppler
bowie-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

huntsman-knife-stained.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Stained
huntsman-knife-stained.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

huntsman-knife-autotronic.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Autotronic
huntsman-knife-autotronic.desc: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been anodized red and uses steel mesh to lighten the weight.

talon-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Talon Knife | Doppler
talon-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

talon-knife-night-stripe.name: ★ Talon Knife | Night Stripe
talon-knife-night-stripe.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

m4a4-cyber-security.name: M4A4 | Cyber Security
m4a4-cyber-security.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. Diagonal bands of blue, red, and gold have been custom painted over this M4's black base.

AVAILABLE NOW AT YOUR LOCAL CYBERNETICS RETAILER

m4a4-aeolian-dark.name: M4A4 | Aeolian Dark
m4a4-aeolian-dark.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. A grayscale, abstract knot pattern has been applied.

Let the wind carry you

m4a1-s-imminent-danger.name: M4A1-S | Imminent Danger
m4a1-s-imminent-danger.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. A custom paint job of multicolored safety signs has been applied.

Don't say I didn't warn you… - Booth, Arms Dealer

m4a1-s-liquidation.name: M4A1-S | Liquidation
m4a1-s-liquidation.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. Its dark base and carefully selected red and blue highlights make this custom painted M4A1-S appear as if it's glowing under ambient light.

Quiet reflection

mac-10-carnivore.name: MAC-10 | Carnivore
mac-10-carnivore.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted using a red and purple hydrographic over a metallic base coat.

Prepare before serving

mac-10-ultraviolet.name: MAC-10 | Ultraviolet
mac-10-ultraviolet.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

mac-10-tornado.name: MAC-10 | Tornado
mac-10-tornado.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a tornado color scheme.

Don't be fooled by its simplicity

mag-7-monster-call.name: MAG-7 | Monster Call
mag-7-monster-call.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been custom painted with a blue base and underwater creatures in the foreground.

There's always a bigger, greener fish

mag-7-core-breach.name: MAG-7 | Core Breach
mag-7-core-breach.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. An orange pattern of radioactive symbols has been applied over a black base.

Safety protocols have failed

mag-7-wildwood.name: MAG-7 | Wildwood
mag-7-wildwood.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. A pattern of "Wildwood" branches and leaves has been applied.

"Are you lost?"

mp5-sd-condition-zero.name: MP5-SD | Condition Zero
mp5-sd-condition-zero.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. Its blue and yellow custom paint job pays homage to Counter-Strike: Condition Zero.

"RPG from three o'clock! Evade!"

mp5-sd-autumn-twilly.name: MP5-SD | Autumn Twilly
mp5-sd-autumn-twilly.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. A red and tan hydrographic pattern of assorted designs has been applied.

Last chance; train's leaving the station

mp7-base-2.name: MP7 | Base-2
mp7-base-2.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been custom painted with 1s and 0s using green and black.

01001101 01010000 00110111

mp9-mount-fuji.name: MP9 | Mount Fuji
mp9-mount-fuji.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. An acrylic painting of Mount Fuji at dawn has been applied. The painting is used as a pattern, so each weapon may appear different.

The red sun rises

mp9-rose-iron.name: MP9 | Rose Iron
mp9-rose-iron.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been hand painted with a rose and thorn motif in metallic paints of different colors.

Beware its many thorns

nova-candy-apple.name: Nova | Candy Apple
nova-candy-apple.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a red and black color scheme.

Great on cars, better on weapons

p250-cartel.name: P250 | Cartel
p250-cartel.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been engraved with skeletons, flowers and serpents.

One little squeeze turns every morning into the Day of the Dead

p250-franklin.name: P250 | Franklin
p250-franklin.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted using a hydrographic of American hundred-dollar bills.

Money doesn't talk... it kills

p250-gunsmoke.name: P250 | Gunsmoke
p250-gunsmoke.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted using a hydrographic of a gel pen doodle.

p250-splash.name: P250 | Splash
p250-splash.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been spray-painted and decorated using a splash-shaped stencil.

r8-revolver-survivalist.name: R8 Revolver | Survivalist
r8-revolver-survivalist.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. Hand painted green stripes allow the owner to blend in and avoid detection in tense situations.

"Eight shots and multiple enemies; better make them count"

sawed-off-clay-ambush.name: Sawed-Off | Clay Ambush
sawed-off-clay-ambush.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. A brown and tan hydrographic tiger pattern has been applied.

Normally solo predators, they'll make an exception for you

sawed-off-sage-spray.name: Sawed-Off | Sage Spray
sawed-off-sage-spray.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors.

Perfect for the insurgent on the go

sg-553-aerial.name: SG 553 | Aerial
sg-553-aerial.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been painted with silver and yellow and given a white wing decal.

Establish air superiority

ssg-08-abyss.name: SSG 08 | Abyss
ssg-08-abyss.desc: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been painted with a hydrographic in an oceanic pattern.

tec-9-groundwater.name: Tec-9 | Groundwater
tec-9-groundwater.desc: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in an olive drab color scheme.

ump-45-briefing.name: UMP-45 | Briefing
ump-45-briefing.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been given a hydrographic of a topographical map.

This is going to be a short meeting...

ump-45-plastique.name: UMP-45 | Plastique
ump-45-plastique.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A custom paint job of wires, a green circuit board, and a number pad has been applied.

73556**

ump-45-corporal.name: UMP-45 | Corporal
ump-45-corporal.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been custom painted in a military motif.

Respect can never be taken, only earned

ump-45-urban-ddpat.name: UMP-45 | Urban DDPAT
ump-45-urban-ddpat.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

xm1014-blue-tire.name: XM1014 | Blue Tire
xm1014-blue-tire.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been spray-painted with a black and blue tire tread pattern.

Burn rubber
